pulls.title: feat(repo): bind convergence economics to episode substrate
pulls.body:
## Scope

Bind convergence CI/queue/owner-cost economics to the existing Experimental Episode/PostgreSQL analytical substrate and freeze the evidence-backed R2 corpus.

Provider base: `7754d0e7c97ab2be4856736d766d4483eb60f65b`
Candidate: `28f9ddddec36218e2f0c23fe4603b88dfeafe36d`

This is a scoped publication slice; it does not publish the unrelated local-only backlog.

## Evidence

- CI observation: 118 GitHub Actions runs.
- CI economic annotations: 29 (`USEFUL=22`, `FAILED_PRODUCTIVELY=5`, `SUPERSEDED=2`); explicit avoidable waste = 0.
- Merge Queue observation: 20 attributed PR / merge-group episodes; requeues = 0; unsuccessful merge groups = 0; observed peak depth lower bound = 2.
- Owner-cost corpus: 19 episodes / 2 candidates in the frozen corpus.
- Experimental Episode projection: 118 CI + 20 Queue + 19 OwnerCost = 157 projections, zero identity collisions.
- PostgreSQL clean-room ingest/replay: first inserts `118/20/19`, replay inserts `0/0/0`.
- Pressure Gate R2: `QUEUE_CONTENTION=NOT_PROVEN`, `HIGH_QUEUE_DEPTH=NOT_PROVEN`, `CI_WASTE/LONG_TAIL_OWNER/PREDICTOR_DATA=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`, `controlsAdmitted=[]`.

## Qualification

Final candidate exact SHA `28f9dddd...`:

- `composition:verify` PASS
- `harness:verify` PASS (1055 tests + 121 subtests)
- `next:verify` PASS
- `skills:verify` PASS
- `web:verify` PASS
- `repo:ci` PASS
- `security:verify`: Python/threat-model checks PASS, then the local Docker carrier fails on `/policies: permission denied`. The same failure reproduces on the unchanged provider base. Locked local OPA `1.20.2` executes the exact policy set `34/34 PASS`, and shellcheck PASS. This is recorded as carrier infrastructure failure, not as Security semantic PASS from the Docker carrier.

The first repo-CI attempt productively rejected a Next-owned fixture containing a Runtime source-path literal; the fixture was made owner-local and repo-CI then passed.

## Boundaries

GitHub Actions / Merge Queue remain provider authority. PostgreSQL is a rebuildable analytical consumer only. No scheduling/control authority is introduced. No O50/O51/O52/S60/B70/M81/M82/M83/custom-scheduler control is admitted by this change.

pulls.title: fix(runtime): bind bootstrap recovery to persisted evidence
pulls.body:
## Why
Live Windows structured release reached the one-shot bootstrap recovery seam for the single historical recovery-required Attempt. The recovery bridge correctly failed closed, but two persisted-evidence contract names did not match the actual Runtime-owned evidence schema:

- persisted supervisor `startEvidenceDigest` binds `windows-launcher-start.json`, not target-writable `windows-start.json`;
- `control-result.json` stores `reasonCode`, not `reason`.

## Change
- bind bootstrap start-evidence verification to `windows-launcher-start.json`;
- read the persisted `reasonCode` field;
- add regression tests using the historical control-result shape and parent-observed launcher evidence filename.

## Verification
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` PASS
- `cargo test --locked -p ordivon-runtime-core --features operator-tools --bin ordivon-runtime-windows-deploy` PASS: 10/10
- live evidence independently confirms the unique historical Attempt is `orphaned + held_orphaned`, has `RUNNER_RESULT_QUARANTINED`, `LaunchIdentityMismatch`, matching parent-observed launcher evidence digest, and dead launcher PID.

pulls.title: runtime: bridge verified Windows release recovery
pulls.body:
## Summary
- allow one explicit, verified historical Windows LaunchIdentityMismatch orphan to pass structured-release preflight/drain without mutating it
- bind the exception to persisted supervisor/start evidence, immutable bundle digests, and candidate launcher proof that the old supervisor is physically absent
- consume the bootstrap authority from the candidate env on successful cutover; existing strict post-cutover Doctor/rollback remains authoritative

## Why
The live Windows Runtime is blocked by one 2026-09-21 orphan whose successful Runner Result was quarantined by the already-fixed repeated-path-separator identity bug (`43726c64`). The old deployer requires zero recovery-required attempts before it can deploy the release containing that fix, creating a bootstrap catch-22.

## Verification
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo test --locked -p ordivon-runtime-core --features operator-tools --bin ordivon-runtime-windows-deploy` (8/8)
- release build of `ordivon-runtime-windows-deploy` on Rust 1.95.0 + MSVC 14.51
- broad package test on Windows was also attempted and is not a valid Windows gate because existing Unix-only tests compile `std::os::unix`, `flock`, and Unix runner code.

## Safety
No direct Registry/SQLite repair. No result reclassification in the deployer. The new Runtime must perform its normal full Windows identity validation/recovery after SCM cutover; post-cutover Doctor must converge to zero recovery-required attempts or the existing rollback path fires.

pulls.title: runtime: verify Windows nested release authority
pulls.body:
## Summary

- make the Windows native deployer distinguish repository publication commit from nested Runtime-owner commit
- bind `sourceOwnerPrefix` for monorepo candidates
- verify `origin/main` in Git at deploy time, including owner-commit ancestry and Runtime owner-tree equality
- retain standalone compatibility while closing the monorepo sibling-commit authority gap

## Why

The Windows structured-release successor is `monorepo-source/services/runtime`. After PR #31 merged, provider `origin/main` is a repository merge commit while the Runtime owner commit remains the last Runtime-touching commit. The old Windows manifest verifier incorrectly required these two SHA-1 identities to be equal, unlike the mature generic deployer owner-tree contract.

## Mechanical gates

- rustfmt ✅
- Windows deployer unit tests 6/6 ✅
- new nested-owner/sibling-main publication test ✅
- Clippy `-D warnings` ✅
- `cargo xwin check ... x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` ✅

No live Runtime, Gateway, service configuration, or credential state is changed by this PR.
